top_signals.title: LME Aluminum Market Faces Biggest Supply Squeeze in Decades
top_signals.summary: Aluminum buyers on the London Metal Exchange are facing the most severe squeeze in decades as inventories backing contracts plunge and much of the remaining stock comes under the control of just two traders.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Lutnick should ban Chinese memory maker CXMT from U.S., Sen. Cotton says
top_signals.summary: Sen. Tom Cotton is urging the Commerce secretary to add CXMT to its "Entity List" as the fast-growing Chinese memory maker expands in DRAM and pushes into HBM.
